# Llama 3.3 70B Instruct

Meta · released 2024-12 · 70B params · llama-3.3

**score 36.8** ±1.3

#167 of 205 · from 19 benchmark results across 15 sources

## How the score was worked out

Each result below implies a score on its own, after adjusting for how hard that test is and who ran it. The model's score is their weighted average. Tests that separate models cleanly and agree with the other tests weigh more. A small pull toward the middle keeps thinly tested models from swinging too far. [Method](../method.md)

## How to run it

api (Amazon Bedrock) · $0.72/M blended · $0.72 in / $0.72 out per 1M tokens · [docs.aws.amazon.com ↗](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock/latest/userguide/models-supported.html)

[price source](https://github.com/anomalyco/models.dev/blob/a668908cfe7073faa0363699486fc41a3ff52412/providers/amazon-bedrock/models/us.meta.llama3-3-70b-instruct-v1:0.toml) · Standard base token rate from models.dev. Provider-specific tiers, long-context surcharges, caching and promotions may differ.

[context specification source](https://github.com/meta-llama/llama-models/blob/0e0b8c519242d5833d8c11bffc1232b77ad7f301/models/llama3_3/MODEL_CARD.md) · Meta Llama 3.3 model card (llama-models repo, pinned): 70B context length 128k (stated rounded). Model ceiling; the priced Amazon Bedrock endpoint may apply its own limit. Observed 2026-09-25.

| local download | size | score | command |
|---|---:|---:|---|
| 4-bit q4\_k\_m | ~42.5GB | 36.8 | `ollama run llama3.3:70b` |
| 2-bit ud-q2\_k\_xl | ~21.5GB | 36.8 | `llama-server -hf unsloth/Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct-GGUF:UD-Q2_K_XL` |

The score is the published model's; quantized downloads haven't been evaluated separately.
